lines.text: Hansel desperately keeps walking, clutching Gretel close.
She tries to call for help,
but no matter where she looks, there isn't a human or Nikke anywhere in sight.
All she can see are Raptures.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's... nobody?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Are all the humans dead?
Hansel fights her way through the swarming Raptures, dragging her battered body along.
Days pass like this before it finally dawns on Hansel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Humanity... lost in the end.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Neither Cinderella... nor Abe... could do it.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We lost... In the end, we lost...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Then does that mean Abe, Cinderella, and Siren...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: all left me behind...!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: N-no... No, no!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: They have to be alive. They wouldn't leave me behind.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Right, Gretel...?
There's not a sound.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Ngh... Hngh...
Hansel holds Gretel tightly.
Even then, Hansel keeps walking, with no end in sight.
Each battle with the Raptures leaves Hansel's body more battered than before.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel... It hurts so much.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I can't even use the Witches Cauldron properly without you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I need to make the ammo, but...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't know how much energy to put into it.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: The more I learn... the more I realize just how amazing you were.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So please...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Even just for a moment... can you open your eyes?
Still nothing.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Even if it's only for a second...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Could you tell me it'll be okay? That you're still here with me?
Silence.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Ngh... Hngh...
Hansel walks on and on.
Finally, she reaches the ruined laboratory.
There, she realizes that two whole years have passed since the day they set out for the Lift.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's no one here...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Abe! Cinderella! Siren!!
There is only silence.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Is there really no one...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Could it be that they're all d—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: N-no... No! They must've gotten lost and are running late.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Yeah...! That's gotta be it. I know I'm right.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: For now... I have to keep Gretel alive.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I have to keep her alive no matter what and wait for Abe...!
Hansel frantically searches the ruined lab.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Found it...!
She places Gretel inside the least damaged healing capsule she can find.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Please work... Please...!
Hansel desperately presses the activation button.
*Gurgle, gurgle*
The empty capsule fills with blue liquid.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: It still works.
Hansel stares at what remains of Gretel, half-submerged in the blue liquid.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... I don't know how long this thing will keep running.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I have to find Abe.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... But what if

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Abe is dead, too...?
*Smack!*
Hansel slaps herself across both cheeks.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I shouldn't think that way.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I have to believe... Abe is alive,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: and so are Cinderella and Siren.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So... they'll all come here and save Gretel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Yeah! I'm sure they will!
However,
even after a year...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: How long has it been...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Should I go look for them...?
Hansel gazes at Gretel in the capsule.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: N-no...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What if someone takes Gretel while I'm out?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I-I have to stay here...
Then another passes...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Wh-why aren't they here yet?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Are they all... dead?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: N-no, I have to believe in them... I'll trust them and wait!
And another...
No matter how long she waits, neither Abe nor Cinderella nor Little Mermaid ever comes.
The only ones left in the crumbling laboratory are Hansel and Gretel, the latter badly damaged.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: When are you coming, Abe...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: How much longer do I have to wait here...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Is everyone dead...?
Hansel stares blankly at Gretel inside the capsule.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What if they're really all dead?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Then should I die, too?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I wanted to live, just like you told me to...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But if everyone's dead... what's the point of me being alive?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Tell me. Please, Gretel.
*Beep, beep, beep, beep*
Hansel heads toward the source of the sound.
"Warning: Low Power."
"Please check the power cable."

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Already...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I've used up every bit of power I could find...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There isn't any left anywhere nearby!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Where can I get more power?!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Think... I have to think. I have to think!
Hansel sprints outside
and cries out desperately.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I-is anyone there?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Help... Please help...!
However, the only ones who come in response to her voice are Raptures.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: All of you... MOVE!
*Boom!*
Hansel takes down the Raptures swarming in at the sound of the commotion,
one
after another...
Only after taking them all down does she finally encounter a reconnaissance squad from the Ark that had followed the Raptures, suspicious of their sudden movement.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Y-you...! Nikkes?!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You're Nikkes... right?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: What...? Why's there a Nikke out here...?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: But weren't we told there were no survivors left on the surface?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: H-help me...! Gretel—I-I mean, there's an injured Nikke in the lab!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: Y-you're asking for help...?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: Don't trust her.
*Click*
The leader of the reconnaissance squad aims her gun at Hansel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Wh-why are you pointing that at me...?!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: It's been years since the Ark was sealed...

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: Yet there are still Nikkes left on the surface?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: And a Nikke that strong just happens to ask for our help when we arrive? The timing is way too convenient.

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: Th-that makes sense.
The other Nikke from the reconnaissance squad also points her gun at Hansel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: N-no! I'm not your enemy!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: ... Something's not right. This could be a trap.

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: Identify yourself.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I-I'm a second generation Grimms model!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: A second generation Grimms model?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: ... Those actually exist?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Yeah, we do. W-we were even called the successors to the Goddess Squad!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: J-just a second. I'll contact someone at the Ark and confirm whether it's true...!
The Nikke from the reconnaissance squad begins contacting the Ark.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You'll know once you check!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: The successor to the Goddess Squad...! If you mention that, they might know.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No, wait... Abe. If you mention Abe, they'll know!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Abe's really famous, after all!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: It's true! Abe made all of us!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: ... We'll find out soon enough if it's true.

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: Th-they said they don't exist?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: ... I'll ask again. Who are you?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You don't know the second generation Grimms models? You don't know us... the ones who were supposed to succeed the Goddess Squad?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You don't know Abe or Si—I mean, Little Mermaid, or Cinderella?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: None of them are in the records.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: None...? There aren't any records of us?

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: She's dangerous. We're pulling back.
The both of them slowly begin to back away.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: D-don't go! It's okay if you don't know us!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's an injured Nikke in here, but we're almost out of power. I won't even be able to keep her alive.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Please help...!
Hansel desperately reaches out her hand.
*Bang!*

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: Stay back!
*Thud, thud, thud, thud*

lines.speaker: locatingforcesnikke
lines.text: L-Leader, this is bad! More Raptures are swarming in...!

lines.speaker: locatingforcesleader
lines.text: So it was a trap after all...! Run!!
The two Nikkes run for their lives.
However...
*Crash!*
A Rapture approaching from the opposite direction kills them.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: A-ahh... Ahhhhh...!
Hansel fights off wave after wave of Raptures,
but never encounters another Nikke.
And so, another day passes.
Hansel returns alone to the research lab, now silent with even the warning lights gone dark.
Hansel trudges through the lab
and stops before Gretel's darkened capsule.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Gretel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: The Ark... doesn't know us.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Abe, Cinderella... Siren, me, and you...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: They don't... know any of us.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Then why...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: why did everyone have to die like that?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Why do you have to die here like this, Gretel? Hm?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't understand.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If the people we fought for were just going to forget about us, why did we risk our lives for them?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What was it all for...? Who was it for...?!
Hansel places her hand on the capsule, now dark with its warning lights out.
Then, she gazes at Gretel inside.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Gretel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't save you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's nothing else I can do... I'm sorry.
*Thump*
Hansel drops to her knees in front of the capsule.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I'm so sorry...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't think... I can do this anymore...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You told me to live, even if I had to be alone...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But I can't.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I... don't want to be alone anymore.
Hansel closes her eyes.
All she wants is to close her eyes beside Gretel
and see her again, even if only in her dreams.
One day, as she waits to drift into eternal sleep...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Is someone there?
Hansel looks up.
*Click, click*
A woman in heels, carrying a parasol, steps into the lab.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: I thought I sensed a presence here...
The woman's gaze shifts to Hansel, who is kneeling in front of the capsule.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: And what do we have here? A little hellion?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Who are you...?!
Hansel looks into the woman's red eyes.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: A Heretic!
Hansel hurriedly pulls out her self-termination pistol and points it at the woman.
*Click*

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What's a Heretic doing here...?!

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: So, you can tell I'm a Heretic.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Hoho... Quite the knowledgeable young lady, aren't you?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Why are you here?!

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: How tiresome.
Bernoullia turns her gaze toward Gretel's capsule.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: So that's why you've been so wary. There was another injured young lady here.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: You put her in here to save her, didn't you?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Just answer my question!
*Bang!*
The woman slams her parasol against the floor.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: I don't converse with those who point a gun at me without so much as a courtesy.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: So you would do well to choose your words carefully.
The woman points at Gretel inside the capsule.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Do you wish to save her life?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You can save her...?

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Do you wish to save her, whatever the cost?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Can you save her?!

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: First, answer my question.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Are you truly prepared to pay whatever price it takes to save her?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Yes... Yes!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If it means saving Gretel... I'll do anything.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Anything, huh...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Haha, how delightful.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: As it happens, I've been in need of a useful slave...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Tell me, Hellion. If I save that girl's life,

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: would you become my slave?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You can save Gretel?

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: I'm not one to lie.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Given her condition...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: It won't come without a price, but I can save her.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Then answer me...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Will you become my slave in exchange for her life?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What's your name...?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Bernoullia.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You'd do well to remember

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: who your master will be.
